title: When vector abundance constrains vector-borne transmission: inside epidemic dynamics within a prescribed population
summary: The global burden of vector-borne diseases continues to rise, presenting escalating challenges to public health and agricultural systems. Their expanding geographic range and associated impacts underscore the need for tools to project disease dynamics and evaluate interventions. Mechanistic compartmental host--vector models provide such a framework by explicitly representing transmission processes. However, while these models often couple vector population dynamics with infection spread, the inherent complexity of vector demographic processes calls for a more modular approach. In this study,…
